cards.name: Void Titan
cards.description: Mythic colossus of absolute destruction. On death, detonates for 40 damage in 120px.
cards.lore: The void does not hunger. It simply consumes.

cards.name: Prism Wyrm
cards.description: Mythic sky serpent. Bypasses walls, flies over all obstacles, fires iridescent blasts.
cards.lore: Light bends around it. So does loyalty.

cards.name: World's End
cards.description: Mythic cataclysm — deals 180 damage to all enemies on the field instantly.
cards.lore: Some spells cannot be uncast.

cards.name: Eternal Forge
cards.description: Mythic structure — forges an armoured knight every 2 seconds. Cannot be destroyed.
cards.lore: The hammer never rests. The forge never cools.

cards.name: Dreadnought
cards.description: Mythic siege engine — absurd HP, unstoppable advance. At 50% HP detonates for 60 AoE.
cards.lore: There is no wall it cannot break. There is no army it cannot outlast.

cards.name: Wizard Academy
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically releases Wizards whose magic bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Knowledge is power. Power is deployable.

cards.name: Barbarian Den
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically releases rampaging Barbarians.
cards.lore: The screaming is intentional. Mostly.

cards.name: Knight Barracks
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically releases armoured Knights.
cards.lore: Honor is a shield. The actual shields help too.

cards.name: Pale Sentry
cards.description: A quick scout of the Marches, half-hidden in mist.
cards.lore: It watched the border for a kingdom no map admits to. Now the maps are wrong, and it knows it.

cards.name: Mist Skirmisher
cards.description: A fast fighter who strikes out of the fog.
cards.lore: You hear the footsteps after the blade. The mist keeps its own order of events.

cards.name: Candle Bearer
cards.description: A robed keeper whose vigil flame scorches at range.
cards.lore: One candle, carried for three hundred years. It has never gone out. Neither has she.

cards.name: Lantern Post
cards.description: A watch-lantern that burns approaching enemies.
cards.lore: The lamps along the Marches were lit before the Fracture. Someone kept them fed.

cards.name: Vigil Prayer
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 6.
cards.lore: The words were written for the dead. They work on the living too.

cards.name: March Ration
cards.description: All friendly mobile units move faster.
cards.lore: Wheat from fields that don't exist. It tastes like a childhood you never had.

cards.name: Marchland Pikeman
cards.description: An armoured line-holder of the border marches.
cards.lore: The pike drill hasn't changed in three centuries. Nothing in Amarath has.

cards.name: Unremembered Soldier
cards.description: A steady infantry soldier of the returned kingdom.
cards.lore: He remembers your great-grandmother's bakery. You don't remember his entire nation.

cards.name: Mist Archer
cards.description: A long-range archer who looses from inside the fog.
cards.lore: She aims at where things were. In the mist, that's where they still are.

cards.name: Pale Rider
cards.description: A swift cavalry outrider of the Pale Court.
cards.lore: The horse was bred in the void. It doesn't cast a shadow, and it minds that you noticed.

cards.name: Candle Shrine
cards.description: A vigil shrine that raises your maximum mana.
cards.lore: Every flame is a name. Feed the shrine and it lends you a few.

cards.name: Mist Barracks
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically releases Mist Skirmishers.
cards.lore: The muster horn is silent. The soldiers come anyway. They've had centuries of practice.

cards.name: Watch Beacon
cards.description: A tall border beacon with long attack range.
cards.lore: It was built to warn Amarath about the Dominion. It works in both directions.

cards.name: Border Palisade
cards.description: A defensive wall of pale marchwood.
cards.lore: The trees it was cut from grew in the void. The axe still hasn't forgiven anyone.

cards.name: Wardstone
cards.description: A heavy warding stone — a wall that endures.
cards.lore: A boundary stone with the kingdom's true name carved on it. Reading it gives you a headache and a memory.

cards.name: Memory Ward
cards.description: All friendly units gain +8 max HP.
cards.lore: Being remembered makes things harder to kill. Amarath learned that the long way.

cards.name: Fog Veil
cards.description: All attacking units gain +15 attack range.
cards.lore: The mist doesn't blind you. It blinds everyone else first.

cards.name: Candlefall
cards.description: Burning wax rains on an area, damaging enemies within it.
cards.lore: Ten thousand vigil candles, tipped at once. The Court calls it mourning. The Marches call it artillery.

cards.name: Pale Vanguard
cards.description: An elite shock-guard of the Herald's escort.
cards.lore: First across the border. First to be forgotten. First to come back.

cards.name: Unremembered Choir
cards.description: A choir whose remembered hymns strike at long range.
cards.lore: They sing the old anthem of the Grand Dominion. Nobody alive on your side knows the words. That's the weapon.

cards.name: Pale Monolith
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically wakes Pale Sentries from the stone.
cards.lore: The census of a lost kingdom, carved standing up. Some entries can still walk.

cards.name: Rite of Return
cards.description: All friendly units gain +12 max HP.
cards.lore: The rite that held a kingdom together in the dark. It holds soldiers together just fine.

cards.name: Knight of the Vigil
cards.description: A towering knight sworn to the vigil, guarding your base.
cards.lore: He stood watch for three hundred years without relief. He does not consider your battle an emergency.

cards.name: The Waiting Mist
cards.description: A drifting mass of vigil-mist that flies over walls.
cards.lore: It isn't weather. It's patience, condensed.

cards.name: The Pale Herald
cards.description: The voice of the Pale Court — an armoured giant bearing the writ of return.
cards.lore: He carries a proclamation with no signatures, because every hand that signed it was erased. He intends to collect them all back.

cards.name: Causeway Sentry
cards.description: A watcher of the toll-road, counting travellers no map remembers.
cards.lore: She counts every traveller on the road, because someone must, and because the counting is the closest thing left to a name.

cards.name: Grey Mile Runner
cards.description: A swift courier who never stops running the causeway.
cards.lore: He has run this mile for three hundred years without once arriving anywhere. The road doesn't end. It just keeps being paid for.

cards.name: Candle Warden
cards.description: A robed toll-keeper whose single candle scorches at range.
cards.lore: One flame, carried at arm's length down an unlit road. She doesn't call it courage. She calls it the job.

cards.name: Causeway Lamp
cards.description: An unlit watch-lamp that ignites against approaching enemies.
cards.lore: Unlit until you're close enough to owe something. Then it burns exactly bright enough to see the toll board.

cards.name: Toll Chit
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 6.
cards.lore: A scrap of paper that says a debt was paid. It is worth nothing anywhere else in the world, and everything here.

cards.name: Debtor's Pace
cards.description: All friendly mobile units move faster.
cards.lore: Walk faster and the toll stays the same. Amarath was never in the business of mercy — only arithmetic.

cards.name: Tollgate Pikeman
cards.description: An armoured line-holder guarding the tollgate.
cards.lore: He has held this gate since before the causeway had a name for what crosses it. He is very good at his one job.

cards.name: Unremembered Toll-Taker
cards.description: A steady infantry collector of the returned kingdom.
cards.lore: She remembers every coin that ever crossed this road, and the face of everyone who paid it. Yours is the first she doesn't.

cards.name: Causeway Archer
cards.description: A long-range archer loosing from the mile markers.
cards.lore: She shoots at silhouettes on the mile markers, because the mist gives her nothing else to aim at.

cards.name: Grey Rider
cards.description: A swift outrider patrolling the causeway.
cards.lore: The horse doesn't tire. Three hundred years of not-existing does that to a thing.

cards.name: Weighbridge Shrine
cards.description: A toll-weighing shrine that raises your maximum mana.
cards.lore: Every traveller is weighed here — not in pounds, in years remembered. Amarath keeps very careful scales.

cards.name: Toll Barracks
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically releases Grey Mile Runners.
cards.lore: Quarters for a garrison that was never relieved, on a road that was never finished being built.

cards.name: Watchlamp Tower
cards.description: A tall causeway tower with long attack range.
cards.lore: Built to watch travellers arrive. Nobody built it to watch them leave.

cards.name: Causeway Rail
cards.description: A defensive rail of quarried grey stone.
cards.lore: Stone quarried from a kingdom that technically didn't exist yet. It holds up fine anyway.

cards.name: Milestone Cairn
cards.description: A stacked cairn of milestones — a wall that endures.
cards.lore: Stacked from the actual milestones — every one that used to mark a mile nobody could find on a map.

cards.name: Ledger of Debts
cards.description: All friendly units gain +8 max HP.
cards.lore: Every name that ever crossed unpaid is written here. The ink has never faded. It has had nothing else to do.

cards.name: Grey Mist Veil
cards.description: All attacking units gain +15 attack range.
cards.lore: The mist over the causeway isn't fog. It's the accumulated breath of everyone still waiting to be let through.

cards.name: Toll Bell Peal
cards.description: The toll bell tolls, damaging enemies within its ring.
cards.lore: One bell, rung for every traveller who couldn't pay. It has not stopped ringing since the day Amarath vanished.

cards.name: Toll Escort
cards.description: An elite guard of the Toll Warden's retinue.
cards.lore: Sworn to the Warden's ledger before sworn to any king. The debt outlived the kingdom that recorded it.

cards.name: Causeway Chorus
cards.description: A chorus whose toll-song strikes at long range.
cards.lore: They sing the toll-song at the gate — the same four verses, three hundred years running. Nobody has ever heard the fifth.

cards.name: Milestone Effigy
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically wakes Causeway Sentries from stone.
cards.lore: Carved in the shape of a mile marker, and just as patient. It remembers exactly how far you have left to go.

cards.name: Writ of Passage
cards.description: All friendly units gain +12 max HP.
cards.lore: Signed by a chancellor who was erased before the ink dried. It is somehow still the only document that matters here.

cards.name: Knight of the Toll
cards.description: A towering knight who guards the tollgate above all else.
cards.lore: He has never once let a debtor pass free. He has also never once demanded a debt he thought unfair.

cards.name: The Endless Ledger
cards.description: A drifting ledger of debts that flies over walls.
cards.lore: It has no pages. It doesn't need them. Every toll ever owed is written on it, and none of them are crossed out.

cards.name: The Toll Warden
cards.description: The lord of the causeway — a titan demanding a toll no traveller can pay.
cards.lore: He does not ask for coin. He asks for centuries — the ones the Dominion's forgetting cost his kingdom. No traveller has ever had that much to give.

cards.name: Field Gleaner
cards.description: A quick-footed gatherer, first through the rows after every harvest memory-wheat has ever grown.
cards.lore: She was gleaning long before there was a war to glean after. Some habits outlast kingdoms.

cards.name: Wheatrow Runner
cards.description: A tireless courier who runs the wheat rows message to message.
cards.lore: He has carried the same message down the same row for three hundred years. He still hasn't found anyone home to deliver it to.

cards.name: Blight-Torch Warden
cards.description: A field warden who burns blight from a distance before it can spread.
cards.lore: One flame, held at arm's length over the grain. She burns what would rot the memory before it takes root.

cards.name: Scarecrow Watch
cards.description: A hollow-eyed scarecrow that strikes at anything crossing its furrow.
cards.lore: It has stood in this furrow since before the furrow had a name. It has never once let anything past that didn't belong.

cards.name: Sheaf-Bread
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 6.
cards.lore: Bread baked from memory-wheat. Eating it doesn't just fill you — it reminds you why you were hungry in the first place.

cards.name: Harvest Haste
cards.description: All friendly mobile units move faster.
cards.lore: The harvest doesn't wait for anyone, least of all the ones bringing it in.

cards.name: Sickle-Line Reaper
cards.description: An armoured reaper holding the line with a sickle built for more than wheat.
cards.lore: He has held this line since the first harvest after the Fracture. He has never once had to explain what he's guarding.

cards.name: Unremembered Harvester
cards.description: A steady infantry harvester of the returned kingdom.
cards.lore: She remembers every stalk that ever crossed this field, and the hand that planted it. Yours is the first she doesn't.

cards.name: Granary Archer
cards.description: A long-range archer loosing arrows from atop the granary roofs.
cards.lore: She shoots at shapes in the mist over the grain, because the mist never gives her anything closer to aim at.

cards.name: Threshing Rider
cards.description: A swift rider who threshes a path through anything in the field.
cards.lore: The horse doesn't tire, and neither does she. Three hundred years of not-existing does that to a rider.

cards.name: Memory-Wheat Silo
cards.description: A grain silo that raises your maximum mana.
cards.lore: Every grain in this silo holds a memory somebody lost. It has never once run empty.

cards.name: Effigy Granary
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically wakes Field Gleaners from stacked sheaves.
cards.lore: The granary doesn't store grain anymore. It stores harvesters, and it has never once been short-staffed.

cards.name: Watchtower Scarecrow
cards.description: A tall scarecrow tower with long attack range.
cards.lore: Built to watch the mist roll in. Nobody built it to watch the mist roll out again.

cards.name: Grain Palisade
cards.description: A defensive palisade of bound wheat-stalks and stone.
cards.lore: Stacked from stalks that grew in a kingdom that technically didn't exist yet. It holds up fine anyway.

cards.name: Sheaf Cairn
cards.description: A stacked cairn of harvested sheaves — a wall that endures.
cards.lore: Every sheaf in this cairn was gleaned by hand, one memory at a time. It is heavier than it looks.

cards.name: Ledger of Gleanings
cards.description: All friendly units gain +8 max HP.
cards.lore: Every memory ever gleaned from the fields is written here. The ink has never faded. It has had nothing else to do.

cards.name: Mistwheat Veil
cards.description: All attacking units gain +15 attack range.
cards.lore: The mist over the fields isn't fog. It's the accumulated breath of everyone still waiting for their name back.

cards.name: Granary Bell
cards.description: The granary bell tolls, damaging enemies within its ring.
cards.lore: One bell, rung for every harvest brought in unwitnessed. It has not stopped ringing since the day Amarath vanished.

cards.name: Queen's Reap-Guard
cards.description: An elite guard of the Gleaner Queen's retinue.
cards.lore: Sworn to the Queen's harvest before sworn to any king. The gleaning outlived the kingdom that ordered it.

cards.name: Chorus of the Threshing Floor
cards.description: A chorus whose threshing-song strikes at long range.
cards.lore: They sing the threshing-song at the floor's centre — the same four verses, three hundred years running. Nobody has ever heard the fifth.

cards.name: Effigy Watch
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically wakes Field Gleaners from stone and straw.
cards.lore: Carved in the shape of a watching harvester, and just as patient. It remembers exactly how much of the field is left to glean.

cards.name: Writ of the Unharvested
cards.description: All friendly units gain +12 max HP.
cards.lore: Signed by a steward who was erased before the ink dried. It is somehow still the only writ that matters in this field.

cards.name: Knight of the Granary
cards.description: A towering knight who guards the granary above all else.
cards.lore: He has never once let a thief past the granary door. He has also never once demanded a debt he thought unfair.

cards.name: The Drifting Scythe
cards.description: A drifting scythe of gleaned memory that flies over walls.
cards.lore: It has no hand to hold it. It doesn't need one. Every memory it has ever gleaned still moves it forward.

cards.name: The Gleaner Queen
cards.description: The sovereign of the fields — a queen who gleans what the world dropped, including, perhaps, what wasn't hers.
cards.lore: She does not glean out of cruelty. She gleans because leaving a memory ungathered, out here, is the same as losing it twice. She has not decided yet whether yours counts as lost.

cards.name: Stack Runner
cards.description: A quick-footed runner who threads the aisles faster than the shelves can close behind her.
cards.lore: She has run the same aisle for three hundred years and never once lost her place in the stacks. The stacks, it must be said, have tried.

cards.name: Lamp Acolyte
cards.description: An acolyte who reads by a portable reading-lamp, and strikes at whatever the light finds first.
cards.lore: She was taught that a name unread is a name still lost. She has not let the wick go out since her ordination.

cards.name: Index Warden
cards.description: A ledger-sworn guard who holds an aisle the way the Archive holds every name it ever shelved.
cards.lore: He does not know whose name is on the shelf behind him. He has decided, three centuries in, that it doesn't matter. It is still his to keep.

cards.name: Reading Lamp
cards.description: A standing reading-lamp that strikes at anything crossing its light.
cards.lore: Lit the day the first name was shelved. It has never once been allowed to gutter — not through the dark, not through the Fracture, not through anything.

cards.name: Parchment Poultice
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 7.
cards.lore: Ground from the endpapers of registers too damaged to shelve. Even ruined, the ink remembers how to mend.

cards.name: Quickening Ink
cards.description: All friendly mobile units move faster.
cards.lore: A cataloguer's trick — ink that writes itself faster than the hand holding the pen. Nobody has ever caught the shelving up.

cards.name: Register Bearer
cards.description: An armoured bearer who carries sealed registers into the line rather than leave them behind.
cards.lore: He has never once dropped a register, not in three hundred years of carrying them. He does not intend to start over you.

cards.name: Hollow Cataloguer
cards.description: A steady cataloguer given a body and a task after its own name was shelved.
cards.lore: It does not remember what it was called. It remembers exactly where it is shelved, down to the row. That is enough to keep working.

cards.name: Lectern Archer
cards.description: A long-range archer loosing arrows from atop the reading lecterns.
cards.lore: She shoots at the dark between the shelves, because the dark is the only part of the Archive that has ever moved on its own.

cards.name: Sealed Courier
cards.description: A swift courier who runs sealed registers between wings faster than the stacks can shift.
cards.lore: The seal on her satchel has never once been broken in transit. She takes that more personally than her own name, which she also no longer has.

cards.name: Index Engine
cards.description: A cataloguing engine that raises your maximum mana.
cards.lore: It cross-references every shelf in the wing at once. Somewhere in that constant reckoning, it found room to spare.

cards.name: Cataloguer Automaton
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically wakes Stack Runners from sealed shelving.
cards.lore: It was built to shelve names, not people. It has stopped drawing the distinction. Nobody has told it to.

cards.name: Watch-Lectern
cards.description: A tall lectern-tower with long attack range.
cards.lore: Built to watch the far stacks for the thing that moves between them. It has never once looked away.

cards.name: Shelf Barricade
cards.description: A defensive barricade built from toppled shelving and bound ledgers.
cards.lore: Every plank in it once held somebody's forgetting. Stacked crosswise, it holds a line instead.

cards.name: Sealed Stack
cards.description: A dense wall of sealed registers, stacked floor to ceiling.
cards.lore: Sealed under the Court's own writ, on the grounds that some names are safer shelved than read. It is heavier than any wall has a right to be.

cards.name: Marginal Notes
cards.description: All friendly units gain +9 max HP.
cards.lore: Every margin in the Archive is written full — corrections, warnings, one word repeated so often it stopped reading like a word at all: remember.

cards.name: Lamp-Oil Reserve
cards.description: All attacking units gain +16 attack range.
cards.lore: Oil rationed for three centuries so the reading-lamps would never once go dark between the shelves. There is, it turns out, more of it than anyone admitted.

cards.name: Silence Bell
cards.description: The silence bell tolls, damaging enemies within its ring.
cards.lore: Rung whenever the reading rooms need quiet enough to hear a name being read for the first time in three hundred years.

cards.name: Archive Warden
cards.description: An elite warden who has guarded the deep stacks since before the Fracture ever needed guarding against.
cards.lore: Sworn to the Archive before sworn to any court. He has stood between the shelves and the thing that feeds on them longer than the thing has been hungry.

cards.name: Choir of Sealed Names
cards.description: A choir of sealed registers that sings the names shelved around it at long range.
cards.lore: They sing the same litany at the reading room's centre, one name a verse, three hundred years running. They have never once reached the end of the shelf.

cards.name: Reading Room Sentry
cards.description: Spawner. Periodically wakes Stack Runners from stone and sealed vellum.
cards.lore: Carved in the shape of a watching cataloguer, and just as patient. It knows exactly how much of the wing is left unshelved.

cards.name: Writ of Erasure
cards.description: All friendly units gain +13 max HP.
cards.lore: Signed to erase a name from the world. It erased the name from everywhere except the shelf that held it, which is, in the Archive's accounting, the only place that ever mattered.

cards.name: Stackbound Knight
cards.description: A towering knight bound to the deep stacks, guarding them above all else.
cards.lore: He has never once let a reader leave with more than they were owed. He has also never once turned away a name that came home on its own.

cards.name: The Unbound Index
cards.description: A drifting index of unshelved pages that flies over walls, hunting for the entry it's missing.
cards.lore: It was never bound into any register. Three hundred years loose in the stacks have taught it to want to be.

cards.name: The Name-Eater
cards.description: The thing between the shelves — prisoner and librarian both, and hungrier than either title admits.
cards.lore: The Court keeps it fed on names nobody will miss. It has never once, in three hundred years, agreed on which names those are.

cards.name: Wick Runner
cards.description: A quick-footed lamplighter's runner who threads the tenements faster than the watch can follow.
cards.lore: She has run the same rooftops for three centuries and never once dropped a wick. The rooftops, it must be said, have tried.

cards.name: Lamplighter Cadet
cards.description: A cadet sworn to hold her post the way the company holds every candle it has ever lit.
cards.lore: She does not know whose window she is guarding. Three centuries of drill taught her it doesn't matter. It is still hers to keep lit.

cards.name: Candle Acolyte
cards.description: An acolyte who reads the watch-rota by candlelight, and strikes at whatever the flame finds first.
cards.lore: She was taught that an unlit window is a district still in the dark. She has not let her taper go out since her ordination.

cards.name: Watch Lamp
cards.description: A standing watch-lamp that strikes at anything crossing its light.
cards.lore: Lit the night the first vigil was sworn. It has never once been allowed to gutter — not through the dark, not through the Fracture, not through anything.

cards.name: Tallow Balm
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 7.
cards.lore: Rendered from tallow too soft to hold a flame. Even unlit, the wax remembers how to mend.

cards.name: Swift Wick
cards.description: All friendly units gain +11 move speed.
cards.lore: A thin-spun wick that burns fast and runs faster. The company issues it to runners who cannot wait for slower fire.

cards.name: Wax Bearer
cards.description: An armoured bearer who carries barrels of reserve wax into the line rather than leave them behind.
cards.lore: He has never once dropped a barrel, not in three centuries of carrying them. He does not intend to start over you.

cards.name: Hollow Snuffer
cards.description: A snuffer-bearer hollowed out by three centuries of putting other people's lights out on command.
cards.lore: He does not ask which candles are due to go dark. He stopped asking the second century in.

cards.name: Sconce Archer
cards.description: An archer posted to a wall-sconce, trading candlelight for a clean line of sight.
cards.lore: She trained on moving targets lit by nothing but her own watch-flame. She has never needed a second lamp.

cards.name: Company Courier
cards.description: A courier who runs the company's orders between districts faster than the wax can cool.
cards.lore: She has carried the same order to eleven districts in one night and arrived before the candles guttered in any of them.

cards.name: Wick Foundry
cards.description: A wick-casting foundry that raises your maximum mana.
cards.lore: It casts a fresh wick for every candle in the district at once. Somewhere in that endless casting, it found wax to spare.

cards.name: Candle Automaton
cards.description: A wax-cast automaton that dispatches a runner down the line at intervals.
cards.lore: Built to relight a street faster than any two hands could manage. It has never once needed to sleep.

cards.name: Beacon Tower
cards.description: A tall beacon-tower with long watch-range over the rooftops.
cards.lore: Built to watch the far districts for the dark that never quite lifts. It has never once looked away.

cards.name: Wax Barricade
cards.description: A defensive barricade cast from cooled wax and bound lamp-crates.
cards.lore: Every block in it once lit somebody's doorway. Stacked crosswise, it holds a line instead.

cards.name: Sealed Sconce
cards.description: A dense wall of sealed wall-sconces, stacked floor to ceiling.
cards.lore: Sealed under Court writ, on the grounds that some flames are safer smothered than lit. It is heavier than any wall has a right to be.

cards.name: Vigil Oil
cards.description: All friendly units gain +9 max HP.
cards.lore: Poured on every threshold in the district — one part oil, one part the promise that the watch will not lapse.

cards.name: Wick Oil Cache
cards.description: All attacking units gain +16 attack range.
cards.lore: A cache the lamplighter companies keep against a longer dark than any of them expect to see.

cards.name: Curfew Bell
cards.description: Deals 7 AOE damage to enemies within range.
cards.lore: Rung the moment curfew breaks. It has never once needed to be rung twice.

cards.name: Company Sergeant
cards.description: A veteran sergeant who has held the night watch since before the Fracture ever needed watching against.
cards.lore: Sworn to the company before sworn to any court. He has held a line between the dark and the district longer than the dark has been patient.

cards.name: Choir of Watch Flames
cards.description: A choir of watch-flames that sings the vigil-rite, striking at anything that steps into curfew.
cards.lore: Every flame in it burns for a name the choir has sworn never to let gutter. It has not lost one yet.

cards.name: Beacon Sentry
cards.description: A sentry-beacon that dispatches a fresh runner down the watch-line at intervals.
cards.lore: Kept burning at the district's highest point since the first vigil was sworn. It has never once let the line go quiet.

cards.name: Curfew Writ
cards.description: All friendly units gain +13 max HP.
cards.lore: Signed to hold a curfew line no matter the cost. It has never once been rescinded, not even for the Fracture.

cards.name: Wickbound Knight
cards.description: A towering knight bound to the company's watch, guarding the vigil line above all else.
cards.lore: He has never once let a district go dark on his watch. He has also never once turned away a flame that came home on its own.

cards.name: The Unbound Flame
cards.description: A flame that answers to no sconce, drifting over the rooftops wherever the watch calls it.
cards.lore: The company does not know how to extinguish it, only where to point it. It has never once needed pointing twice.

cards.name: The Lamplighter General
cards.description: Commander of the city's flame-keepers — three centuries of drill made doctrine, and doctrine made a weapon.
cards.lore: The Court gave her a city of candles to keep. She has never once needed reminding which ones to snuff.

cards.name: Tideborn Wader
cards.description: A shallow-water runner who crosses the misaligned tideline faster than the currents can catch her.
cards.lore: She has waded the same drowned street for three centuries and never once lost her footing. The street, it must be said, has tried.

cards.name: Brine Scout
cards.description: A scout who reads the new tide the way old maps read roads — carefully, and never twice the same way.
cards.lore: The border moves under her feet more than any border should. She has stopped expecting it to hold still.

cards.name: Drowned Watchman
cards.description: A watchman posted on a tower that drowned and rose again, still counting who crosses the new waterline.
cards.lore: He has stood the same post since before the Fracture took the coast away. He did not notice it was gone. He has not yet noticed it came back.

cards.name: Tidebell
cards.description: A standing tide-bell that rings out at anything crossing the waterline.
cards.lore: Cast the night the border first came back wrong. It has never once missed the tide's turning.

cards.name: Kelp Poultice
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 7.
cards.lore: Bound from kelp that grew in water that shouldn't exist yet. It mends what the tide didn't finish taking.

cards.name: Undertow Charm
cards.description: All friendly units move faster, carried by the pull of an undertow that isn't really there.
cards.lore: A charm cut from driftwood that drifted the wrong way. Carry it, and so will you.

cards.name: Barnacle Guard
cards.description: A guard crusted in three centuries of barnacle growth — slow to move, slower to fall.
cards.lore: The shell isn't armor. It's just how long he's stood in one place, letting the tide decide what grows on him.

cards.name: Hollow Tidecaller
cards.description: A caller who has learned to speak in a tongue the tide itself seems to answer to.
cards.lore: Nobody taught her the calling-tongue. She says the water taught itself to her, one drowned name at a time.

cards.name: Driftwood Archer
cards.description: An archer who strings driftwood bows salvaged from towers the tide never should have reached.
cards.lore: Every bow she's ever drawn came out of the water first. She has stopped asking where the wood used to stand.

cards.name: Tide Courier
cards.description: A courier who runs the causeway between tides, carrying orders the Court insists still matter.
cards.lore: He has never once been late, and the tide has never once let him take the same road twice.

cards.name: Sunken Barricade
cards.description: A barricade built from a drowned tower's own stones, still holding the shape it had before the water came.
cards.lore: Nobody rebuilt it. It simply stopped being underwater one morning, exactly where it used to stand.

cards.name: Pearl Foundry
cards.description: A foundry that culls mana from pearls the tide keeps giving back.
cards.lore: Every pearl it opens holds a little more mana than the last. Nobody has explained why. Nobody wants to be the one who does.

cards.name: Drowned Automaton
cards.description: An automaton that wades the shallows on a loop, casting off runners the way a wave casts off foam.
cards.lore: It has walked the same stretch of drowned road since before anyone alive remembers the road being dry.

cards.name: Envoy Watchtower
cards.description: A tall watchtower raised on stilts against a tide that keeps changing its mind about the shoreline.
cards.lore: Built to watch the horizon for a vanguard that already arrived. It has not stopped watching since.

cards.name: Sealed Tidegate
cards.description: A tidegate sealed on Court orders, holding back water that isn't rising anymore — just remembering how to.
cards.lore: Nobody has opened it in three centuries. It still knows exactly how, if it's ever asked to.

cards.name: Brine Draught
cards.description: All friendly units gain +9 max HP.
cards.lore: Brewed from brine thick enough to hold a memory. Drink it, and you hold a little more, too.

cards.name: Pearl Cache
cards.description: All friendly ranged units gain +16 range.
cards.lore: A cache of pearls that see further than they should, for things that were never meant to have eyes.

cards.name: Undertow Toll
cards.description: Deals 7 damage to all enemies within range.
cards.lore: The toll the causeway charges anything that tries to cross without paying the tide first.

cards.name: Envoy Vanguard
cards.description: The Drowned Envoy's own vanguard, first ashore on every crossing the Court has ever ordered.
cards.lore: They do not remember choosing to go first. They remember only that someone always has, and it is always them.

cards.name: Choir of the Drowned
cards.description: A choir that sings the old tide-hymns in voices that never quite dried out.
cards.lore: They have been singing the same hymn since before the void. The tide has learned the words better than they have.

cards.name: Pearl Sentry
cards.description: A sentry built around a single black pearl that keeps casting off wader-runners, tide after tide.
cards.lore: Nobody has ever found where the pearl gets its runners from. The pearl has never once run out.

cards.name: Envoy's Writ
cards.description: All friendly units gain +13 max HP.
cards.lore: A writ signed by the Court and countersigned by the tide, promising that nothing sent across the border goes under twice.

cards.name: Drowned Knight
cards.description: A knight who has drowned and risen with the border so many times he no longer counts the crossings.
cards.lore: He does not remember dying. He remembers only that the water always gives him back, and he has stopped asking it not to.

cards.name: The Undertow
cards.description: A wave given a shape and a grudge, pulled along by a current that answers only to the Envoy.
cards.lore: It was a wave once, and only a wave. Something in the crossing taught it to want.

cards.name: The Drowned Envoy
cards.description: The Court's herald to the drowned coast — first to cross the new tide, first to be believed by nobody who saw the border move.
cards.lore: The Court sent an envoy to a coastline that didn't exist yet. It came back with a title, a retinue, and a tide that follows wherever it walks.

cards.name: Reed Strider
cards.description: A quick-footed scout who crosses the marsh reeds faster than the still water can betray her.
cards.lore: She learned the marsh's paths by watching her own reflection walk them first. It has never once led her wrong.

cards.name: Marsh Skulker
cards.description: A skulker who moves low through the reeds, careful never to break the water's surface.
cards.lore: The marsh punishes anyone who disturbs its stillness. He has not disturbed it once in ten years.

cards.name: Glasswater Scout
cards.description: A scout stationed where the marsh water lies flattest, watching for anything the reflection shouldn't show.
cards.lore: She has stood the same post since before the Fracture took the marsh away. The reflection remembers her better than the Court's rosters do.

cards.name: Still Bell
cards.description: A standing bell that rings out the instant the marsh's surface breaks.
cards.lore: Cast the night the marsh first learned to hold a reflection. It has never once rung for nothing.

cards.name: Reed Poultice
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 7.
cards.lore: Bound from reeds that grew in water reflecting a sky that isn't there anymore. It mends what the stillness didn't finish taking.

cards.name: Mirror Step
cards.description: All friendly units move faster, stepping where their reflections already stood.
cards.lore: A charm cut from glass that shows the step before you take it. Follow it, and you arrive a little sooner than you should.

cards.name: Marsh Guard
cards.description: A guard who has stood in the shallows so long the reeds have grown through his armor.
cards.lore: The reeds aren't decoration. They're just how long he's stood in one place, letting the marsh decide what grows on him.

cards.name: Echo Caller
cards.description: A caller who speaks to the marsh in a tongue the water's reflection seems to answer back.
cards.lore: Nobody taught her the calling-tongue. She says her own reflection taught it to her, one still evening at a time.

cards.name: Reedline Archer
cards.description: An archer who strings bows cut from reeds tall enough to remember the world before the Fracture.
cards.lore: Every reed she cuts shows her something the marsh saw before the void. She has stopped asking it to stop.

cards.name: Marsh Runner
cards.description: A runner who crosses the marsh causeways carrying orders the Court insists still matter.
cards.lore: He has never once broken the water's surface running it, and the marsh has never once let him take the same path twice.

cards.name: Reed Barricade
cards.description: A barricade woven from reeds thick enough to hold their shape against anything that disturbs the marsh.
cards.lore: Nobody wove it. It simply grew that way, exactly where the marsh needed it to stand.

cards.name: Glass Foundry
cards.description: A foundry that culls mana from marsh-glass the reflection keeps giving back.
cards.lore: Every pane it casts holds a little more mana than the last. Nobody has explained why. Nobody wants to be the one who does.

cards.name: Reflection Automaton
cards.description: An automaton that walks the reed-line on a loop, casting off runners the way still water casts off ripples.
cards.lore: It has walked the same stretch of reed-line since before anyone alive remembers the marsh being dry.

cards.name: Marsh Watchtower
cards.description: A tall watchtower raised on stilts above a marsh that keeps changing its mind about what it reflects.
cards.lore: Built to watch the water for a vanguard that already arrived. It has not stopped watching since.

cards.name: Sealed Millpond
cards.description: A millpond sealed on Court orders, holding still water that isn't rising anymore — just remembering how to.
cards.lore: Nobody has opened its sluice in three centuries. It still knows exactly how, if it's ever asked to.

cards.name: Marsh Draught
cards.description: All friendly units gain +9 max HP.
cards.lore: Brewed from marsh water thick enough to hold a memory. Drink it, and you hold a little more, too.

cards.name: Glass Lens
cards.description: All friendly ranged units gain +16 range.
cards.lore: A lens ground from marsh-glass that sees further than it should, for things that were never meant to have eyes.

cards.name: Echo Toll
cards.description: Deals 7 damage to all enemies within range.
cards.lore: The toll the marsh charges anything that tries to cross its stillness without paying an echo first.

cards.name: Marsh Vanguard
cards.description: The Reflection's own vanguard, first to step from the water on every crossing the Court has ever ordered.
cards.lore: They do not remember stepping out first. They remember only that someone always has, and it is always them.

cards.name: Choir of Echoes
cards.description: A choir that sings the old marsh-hymns in voices that answer themselves back across the water.
cards.lore: They have been singing the same hymn since before the void. The water has learned to sing it back better than they do.

cards.name: Glass Sentry
cards.description: A sentry built around a single shard of marsh-glass that keeps casting off reed-runners, still water after still water.
cards.lore: Nobody has ever found where the shard gets its runners from. The shard has never once run out.

cards.name: Mirror Writ
cards.description: All friendly units gain +13 max HP.
cards.lore: A writ signed by the Court and countersigned by the reflection, promising that nothing sent across the marsh comes back only once.

cards.name: Marsh Knight
cards.description: A knight who has crossed the marsh's stillness so many times he no longer counts the reflections.
cards.lore: He does not remember which crossing was the real one. He remembers only that the water always gives him back, and he has stopped asking it not to.

cards.name: The Echo
cards.description: A reflection given a shape and a grudge, pulled along by a stillness that answers only to the one it mirrors.
cards.lore: It was a reflection once, and only a reflection. Something in the crossing taught it to want a body of its own.

cards.name: The Reflection
cards.description: The Court's herald to the still water — showing the world exactly as it was before the Fracture, and daring the Worldmender to prefer it.
cards.lore: The Court sent a herald to a marsh that remembers everything. It came back wearing a face the Fracture should have erased.

cards.name: Masked Page
cards.description: A quick-footed page who runs the Hollow Court's corridors wearing a mask two sizes too old for her.
cards.lore: She was given the mask before she could remember her own face well enough to miss it. She runs faster than anyone who still has one to lose.

cards.name: Court Attendant
cards.description: An attendant who moves through the Court's halls the way the ceremony demands, mask first.
cards.lore: The ceremony has a step for everything, including how to enter a room you no longer recognize.

cards.name: Silver Herald
cards.description: A herald stationed where the Court's silver masks catch the most candlelight.
cards.lore: She has announced every noble who's ever entered this hall by title, never by name. Nobody has corrected her in three centuries.

cards.name: Velvet Sconce
cards.description: A standing sconce, draped in Court velvet, that strikes at anything crossing its light.
cards.lore: Lit the night the first mask was carved. It has never once been allowed to gutter in front of company.

cards.name: Powdered Balm
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 7.
cards.lore: Powder pressed for a face nobody in the Court remembers wearing it. It still knows how to mend one.

cards.name: Courtly Step
cards.description: All friendly units move faster, keeping the ceremony's exact pace.
cards.lore: A step taught before anyone could ask why. Follow it, and you cross a hall like you were born to the title.

cards.name: Masked Guard
cards.description: A guard who has worn the same silver mask so long the seam has fused to his jaw.
cards.lore: The mask isn't a uniform anymore. It's just how long he's stood post, letting the Court decide who he is.

cards.name: Hollow Chanter
cards.description: A chanter who leads the Court's ceremonies in a voice that answers itself back through empty halls.
cards.lore: Nobody taught her the ceremony-tongue. She says the halls taught it to her, one echo at a time.

cards.name: Silver Archer
cards.description: An archer who strings bows forged from mask-silver melted down for want of a face to cover.
cards.lore: Every arrow she looses came from a mask somebody stopped needing. She has stopped asking why the pile keeps growing.

cards.name: Court Courier
cards.description: A courier who runs the Court's corridors carrying orders the Chamberlain insists still matter.
cards.lore: He has never once removed his mask running them, and the Court has never once let him take the same corridor twice.

cards.name: Velvet Barricade
cards.description: A barricade of Court velvet draped over stone, ceremonial and immovable in equal measure.
cards.lore: Nobody hung it. It simply grew that way, exactly where the ceremony needed it to stand.

cards.name: Mask Foundry
cards.description: A foundry that culls mana from silver masks the Court keeps casting and never wearing twice.
cards.lore: Every mask it casts holds a little more mana than the last. Nobody has explained why. Nobody wants to be the one who does.

cards.name: Court Automaton
cards.description: An automaton that walks the Court's corridors on a loop, casting off pages the way a ceremony casts off names.
cards.lore: It has walked the same corridor since before anyone alive remembers the Court having a face to keep.

cards.name: Hollow Watchtower
cards.description: A tall watchtower raised above the Court that keeps changing its mind about who's still allowed to be recognized.
cards.lore: Built to watch the halls for a vanguard that already arrived. It has not stopped watching since.

cards.name: Sealed Archive
cards.description: An archive sealed on Court orders, holding names that aren't being read anymore — just remembered.
cards.lore: Nobody has opened its ledgers in three centuries. It still knows every name inside, if it's ever asked to.

cards.name: Court Draught
cards.description: All friendly units gain +9 max HP.
cards.lore: Brewed from Court wine thick enough to hold a memory. Drink it, and you hold a little more, too.

cards.name: Silver Lens
cards.description: All friendly ranged units gain +16 range.
cards.lore: A lens ground from mask-silver that sees further than it should, for things that were never meant to have eyes.

cards.name: Gesture Toll
cards.description: Deals 7 damage to all enemies within range.
cards.lore: The toll the ceremony charges anything that tries to cross its floor without the correct gesture first.

cards.name: Court Vanguard
cards.description: The Chamberlain's own vanguard, first to enter the hall on every ceremony the Court has ever ordered.
cards.lore: They do not remember entering first. They remember only that someone always has, and it is always them.

cards.name: Choir of Masks
cards.description: A choir that sings the old Court hymns from behind silver faces that never once slip.
cards.lore: They have been singing the same hymn since before the void. The masks have learned to sing it back better than they do.

cards.name: Mask Sentry
cards.description: A sentry built around a single unworn mask that keeps casting off pages, ceremony after ceremony.
cards.lore: Nobody has ever found where the mask gets its pages from. The mask has never once run out.

cards.name: Court Writ
cards.description: All friendly units gain +13 max HP.
cards.lore: A writ signed by the Chamberlain and countersigned by nobody the Court still remembers, promising every mask a face to return to.

cards.name: Masked Knight
cards.description: A knight who has worn so many Court masks he no longer remembers which one covers his own face.
cards.lore: He does not remember which mask was first. He remembers only that the Court always gives him another, and he has stopped asking it not to.

cards.name: The Unmasked
cards.description: A courtier given a shape and a grudge, freed of the mask the Court insists everyone still needs.
cards.lore: It was a mask once, and only a mask. Something in the crossing taught it to want a face of its own.

cards.name: The Chamberlain
cards.description: The Court's own steward, first to enter every hall and the last to admit the Court forgot its own faces.
cards.lore: The Court gave him a ceremony to keep. He has never once needed reminding which gesture erases a name.

cards.name: Frost Runner
cards.description: A quick-footed runner who crosses ground the waited winter hasn't finished claiming yet.
cards.lore: The frost hasn't decided whether to take her feet yet. She has stopped waiting to find out.

cards.name: Waiting Scout
cards.description: A scout who has learned to move the way a stored season moves — slow, then all at once.
cards.lore: She waited three centuries in the void without complaint. She has run out of patience for anything that asks her to wait again.

cards.name: Rime Herald
cards.description: A herald stationed where the rime forms thickest, announcing a winter nobody scheduled.
cards.lore: She has announced the same released winter for three centuries. Nobody has told her it already arrived.

cards.name: Frost Sconce
cards.description: A standing sconce, rimed over, that strikes at anything crossing the waited cold.
cards.lore: Lit the night the winter first came out of storage. It has never once been allowed to gutter in the cold.

cards.name: Snow Balm
cards.description: Heals all friendly units by 7.
cards.lore: Rendered from snow that waited three centuries to fall. It still knows how to mend what the cold didn't finish taking.

cards.name: Waited Step
cards.description: All friendly units move faster, carried by a season that's done waiting.
cards.lore: A charm cut from ice that waited too long to melt. Carry it, and so will you.

cards.name: Frost Guard
cards.description: A guard rimed over so long the frost has fused to his armor's seams.
cards.lore: The rime isn't decoration. It's just how long he's stood in one place, letting the waited winter decide what grows on him.

cards.name: Rime Chanter
cards.description: A chanter who has learned to speak in a tongue the released winter seems to answer to.
cards.lore: Nobody taught her the calling-tongue. She says the cold taught itself to her, one waited season at a time.

cards.name: Icebound Archer
cards.description: An archer who strings bows carved from ice that waited three centuries to be anything else.
cards.lore: Every arrow she looses came from ice that waited longer than she has been alive. She has stopped asking it to wait for her too.

cards.name: Winter Courier
cards.description: A courier who runs the frost-roads carrying orders the Court insists still matter.
cards.lore: He has never once been late, and the waited winter has never once let him take the same road twice.

cards.name: Frost Barricade
cards.description: A barricade built from ice that waited three centuries to be anything other than storage.
cards.lore: Nobody built it. It simply stopped being stored one morning, exactly where the winter needed it to stand.

cards.name: Snowmelt Foundry
cards.description: A foundry that culls mana from snowmelt the waited winter keeps giving back.
cards.lore: Every drop it melts holds a little more mana than the last. Nobody has explained why. Nobody wants to be the one who does.

cards.name: Frost Automaton
cards.description: An automaton that walks the frost-roads on a loop, casting off runners the way a thaw casts off ice.
cards.lore: It has walked the same stretch of frozen road since before anyone alive remembers the winter waiting to be released.

cards.name: Rime Watchtower
cards.description: A tall watchtower raised above the frost that keeps changing its mind about how deep the cold should run.
cards.lore: Built to watch the horizon for a vanguard that already arrived. It has not stopped watching since.

cards.name: Sealed Icehouse
cards.description: An icehouse sealed on Court orders, holding a season that isn't waiting anymore — just remembering how to.
cards.lore: Nobody has opened it in three centuries. It still knows exactly how cold it's supposed to be, if it's ever asked to.

cards.name: Winter Draught
cards.description: All friendly units gain +9 max HP.
cards.lore: Brewed from ice thick enough to hold a memory. Drink it, and you hold a little more, too.

cards.name: Frost Lens
cards.description: All friendly ranged units gain +16 range.
cards.lore: A lens ground from ice that sees further than it should, for things that were never meant to have eyes.

cards.name: Blizzard Toll
cards.description: Deals 7 damage to all enemies within range.
cards.lore: The toll the waited winter charges anything that tries to cross its frost without paying the cold first.

cards.name: Winter Vanguard
cards.description: The Frost Regent's own vanguard, first to cross the frost-line on every march the Court has ever ordered.
cards.lore: They do not remember choosing to go first. They remember only that someone always has, and it is always them.

cards.name: Choir of Frost
cards.description: A choir that sings the old winter-hymns in voices that never quite thawed out.
cards.lore: They have been singing the same hymn since before the void. The frost has learned the words better than they have.

cards.name: Snowbound Sentry
cards.description: A sentry built around a single unmelting snowflake that keeps casting off runners, winter after waited winter.
cards.lore: Nobody has ever found where the snowflake gets its runners from. The snowflake has never once run out.

cards.name: Winter Writ
cards.description: All friendly units gain +13 max HP.
cards.lore: A writ signed by the Court and countersigned by the cold, promising that nothing sent into the frost goes under twice.

cards.name: Frostbound Knight
cards.description: A knight who has waited out the winter so many times he no longer counts the seasons.
cards.lore: He does not remember the first frost. He remembers only that the cold always gives him back, and he has stopped asking it not to.

cards.name: The Waited Cold
cards.description: A season given a shape and a grudge, released from storage after three centuries with nothing to answer to but itself.
cards.lore: It was a season once, and only a season. Something in the waiting taught it to want.

cards.name: The Frost Regent
cards.description: The Court's own weapon — a winter stored for three centuries and finally given someone to release it upon.
cards.lore: The Court kept a season in the void until it needed one. It came back with a crown, a retinue, and a cold that follows wherever it walks.

heroCards.name: Dragon Lord
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mighty Dragon & grants all units +6 attack! At half health the Dragon erupts in a fire breath AoE.
heroCards.lore: Commands dragons. Dragons pretend not to notice.

heroCards.name: Battle Queen
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys an armored Paladin & fortifies all units with +20 max HP! At half health the Paladin unleashes a divine smite AoE.
heroCards.lore: Won sixteen wars. Lost zero negotiations.

heroCards.name: Storm Caller
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a fearsome Wyvern & blesses all units with +40 attack range! At half health the Wyvern calls down a lightning strike AoE.
heroCards.lore: The sky does what she says. Eventually.

heroCards.name: Shadow King
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a savage Werewolf & surges all units with +25 speed!
heroCards.lore: Feared in twelve kingdoms. Banned from two taverns specifically.

heroCards.name: Death Lord
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a sinister Lich Apprentice who summons a skeleton army & hastens all units with -500ms attack cooldown!
heroCards.lore: Death is just a job. A very grim job, but somebody's got to do it.

heroCards.name: Forest Guardian
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mighty Elder Treant & rejuvenates all units with +4 HP heal every 10s! At half health the Treant erupts in a bark burst AoE.
heroCards.lore: The forest is alive. It has opinions on your strategy.

heroCards.name: Swarm Queen
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mischievous Pixie & commands it to spawn a Spore Bat for you every 10s!
heroCards.lore: The swarm is a family. A very bitey family.

heroCards.name: Graham The All Seeing
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys Skeleton Archers!
heroCards.lore: Sees all. Knows all. Still can't find his keys. Play tested by Graham, who is indeed all seeing.

heroCards.name: Rob The Reckless
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys Rob — a reckless wizard who explodes on death, blasting all nearby enemies! Also grants all units +3 attack.
heroCards.lore: Big smile. Bigger explosions. The glasses are purely decorative.

heroCards.name: Blast Maiden
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Blast Maiden — a fearless warrior carrying explosives. On death she detonates for massive AoE damage! All units also gain +15 max HP.
heroCards.lore: She doesn't fear death. Death fears the radius.

heroCards.name: Phantom Dasher
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Phantom — a spectral archer who teleports forward every 5.5s, bypassing obstacles! All units gain +12 speed.
heroCards.lore: Location is a state of mind. Mind is overrated.

heroCards.name: Shadow
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Shadow Stalker — a fast melee assassin who vanishes into invisibility periodically, becoming untargetable! All units also gain -400ms attack cooldown.
heroCards.lore: Always watching. Never seen.

heroCards.name: Blood Summoner
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Blood Summoner — a dark mage who raises Blood Wraiths from fallen enemies' blood pools every 5s! All units are also healed for 10 HP.
heroCards.lore: Blood doesn't lie. It just... gets around.

heroCards.name: The Builder
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Builder — repairs or upgrades a building every 3s (3 charges). After all charges are spent, he sprints to the enemy base avoiding enemies and detonates on the first enemy building he reaches! All units gain +18 max HP.
heroCards.lore: Can fix anything. Given enough time. And lumber.

heroCards.name: Warden of the Marches
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Marches Warden — a border commander who holds the line near your base and engages anything that crosses it. All units gain +12 max HP.
heroCards.lore: The Dominion never posted a warden to the eastern blank. Somebody took the job anyway.

heroCards.name: Causeway Guide
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Grey Guide — a causeway pathfinder who holds the line near your base and engages anything that crosses it. All units gain +14 max HP.
heroCards.lore: No map shows the causeway's true turns. She walked it before the mist had a name for it, and she still knows every unlit lamp by heart.

heroCards.name: First Reaper
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the First Reaper — the harvester who cut the very first sheaf of memory-wheat in the void. All units gain +3 attack.
heroCards.lore: Nobody ordained her the first. She simply refused to let the field go unharvested while there was still a hand left to hold the sickle. Three centuries on, the fields still cut the way she taught them.

heroCards.name: The Archivist Returned
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Returned Archivist — a Dominion archivist whose own name was gleaned back from the Archive's stacks. All units gain +8 max HP.
heroCards.lore: Campaign 1 knew an Archivist who never left the Crystal Spire. This one is not him — only someone who once did the same work, in a kingdom that no longer had a name to file her under. The Archive gave hers back. She has not stopped reading since.

heroCards.name: Candle Sergeant
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Candle Sergeant — a lamplighter company officer who broke ranks rather than snuff a district on Court orders. All units gain +8 max HP.
heroCards.lore: She held the vigil-flame at Threadneedle Row when the writ came down to let it gutter. She refused, and the company did not report her — not one of them. She marches with Jarv now, still carrying the same candle.

heroCards.name: Tide Warden
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Tide Warden — a company guide who reads the misaligned tide better than the Court's own maps. All units move faster.
heroCards.lore: She crossed the causeway before the Court finished deciding it existed. She has been one step ahead of the tide ever since, and one step ahead of Jarv now.

heroCards.name: Marsh Pathfinder
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Marsh Pathfinder — a guide who has crossed the Mirror Marsh so many times the reflection stopped bothering to mislead her. All units gain +10 max HP.
heroCards.lore: She reads the marsh by what the water refuses to show back. She has never once led anyone into a reflection instead of a path.

heroCards.name: Masked Duelist
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Masked Duelist — a courtier who traded the Court's ceremony for a blade the moment the mask came off. All units attack faster.
heroCards.lore: She unmasked herself in front of the whole Court and dared them to still recognize her. Nobody did. She has been faster than the ceremony ever since.

heroCards.name: Winter Warden
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys the Winter Warden — a keeper who outlasted three centuries of stored cold without losing anyone under her watch. Heals all friendly units by 5.
heroCards.lore: She warded the winter in storage for three hundred years and never once let it take someone she was watching. She watches Jarv's line now the same way.
